product: VK2735 is a dual GLP-1 and GIP receptor agonist in subcutaneous and oral formulations for obesity, now in Phase 3 (VANQUISH-1 and VANQUISH-2). Pipeline also includes VK3019 (amylin receptor agonist, Phase 1), VK2809 (THR-beta for MASH and liver disease), VK0214 (THR-beta for X-ALD) and VK5211.
demand: Obesity and metabolic disease are a large unmet market; Viking is pre-revenue and demand is inferred from clinical efficacy and enrollment speed, with VANQUISH-1 enrolling about 4,500 patients in roughly five months.
pricing_power: Not measurable pre-commercial. Viking frames differentiation on efficacy, having both oral and injectable options, and flexible maintenance dosing rather than price; ultimate pricing would be payer-driven in the obesity market.
competition: Crowded obesity field. Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly lead with marketed GLP-1 and GLP-1/GIP products; Viking cites oral GLP-1 mono-agonists already available and aims to be the first oral dual GLP-1/GIP. Amgen and other incretin and amylin developers also compete.
team: Led by chief executive officer Brian Lian, Ph.D. During Q2 2026 Viking appointed Hubert Chen, M.D. as chief medical officer, adding obesity, metabolic, endocrinology and regulatory leadership.
market_strategy: Advance subcutaneous VK2735 through the VANQUISH Phase 3 registration program, start oral VK2735 Phase 3 in Q4 2026, explore monthly and every-other-week maintenance regimens to improve adherence, and fund development with a 500 million dollar equity and convertible-note raise.
bull: 2026-09-22 positive maintenance data: 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at week 33, no plateau, up to 97% maintained on every-other-week dosing; VANQUISH Phase 3 fully enrolled; oral Phase 3 starts Q4 2026.
bear: Favorable data are from a small exploratory Phase 1, not a pivotal endpoint; the 2026-09-24 raise priced common at $35 versus a $41.65 close, and shares fell 11.76% to $36.75; FY2026 losses near $540M with no revenue.
falsifier: VANQUISH-1 or VANQUISH-2 78-week topline readout missing its primary efficacy or tolerability endpoint, or oral VK2735 Phase 3 failing to begin by Q4 2026.
web_what_changed: 2026-09-22 Viking reported positive topline maintenance-study data for subcutaneous VK2735: 22 percent placebo-adjusted weight loss at week 33 on 17.5 mg weekly with no plateau, up to 97 percent of loss maintained on every-other-week and 90 percent on monthly dosing. 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24 it announced and priced an upsized 500 million dollar equity-plus-convertible offering. 2026-07-29 Q2 showed VANQUISH Phase 3 fully enrolled.
web_not_known_yesterday: As of 2026-09-24 the offering was priced and upsized to about 500 million dollars: 7,857,143 common shares at 35.00 dollars plus 225 million dollars of 2.00 percent convertible notes due 2032 with a 50.75 dollar conversion price. Value rests on clinical demand signal (obesity efficacy and tolerability) and volume potential in a large obesity market. Pricing power is prospective and payer-driven; the Sep 22 data support dosing flexibility, not measured price.
